input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for edgeservice application, sleuth response filter. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with calculation functionality, so that I can accomplish my calculation-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with frontend functionality, so that I can accomplish my frontend-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to use edgeservice application capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
